name: Asteroid Dreadnought
description: The Asteroid Dreadnought was a rumored Imperial Navy dreadnought that was camouflaged as a space rock during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, Colonel Haxen Delto of Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service wrote a report to Chief of Rebel Intelligence General Airen Cracken on Imperial superweapon projects, and included a section in the report regarding the rumors of the dreadnought.
